setting.help: Default for new Gate Passes: send to Waiting Security before Posted. This is only the default — it can be overridden per Gate Pass (field 'Requires Security Clearance') before it is posted, and whether a Gate Pass is required at all before validating a transfer is set per Operation Type under Inventory → Configuration → Operation Types.
